name: compliance-automation-evaluation
description: JEV criteria for evaluating optimal compliance automation actions based on requirement data, system configuration, and historical remediation outcomes

options.description: Enable multi-factor authentication for all users
Increase password complexity and reduce expiry interval
Implement periodic access review process with automated reminders
Enable encryption for data at rest using industry-standard algorithms
Add network segmentation to isolate sensitive systems from general traffic

evaluation_factors: Compliance requirement severity, standard (SOC2/HIPAA/PCI), and control ID
Current system configuration including existing security controls and gaps
Historical success rates for each remediation action in similar compliance scenarios
Time sensitivity and potential impact on users during compliance remediation process
Risk of introducing new issues with more invasive compliance approaches
